description: This file defines an interface for managing input method (IME) settings within the Android input method framework. It provides method signatures for setting titles and icons for input method settings categories and subtype enabler preferences, facilitating UI customization for input method configurations.

classes.name: InputMethodSettingsInterface
classes.description: Interface for customizing input method settings UI, including setting titles and icons for related preferences.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the input method settings category; overloads accept resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the subtype enabler preference; overloads accept resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the subtype enabler preference; overloads accept resource ID or Drawable.
